task_completion_reasoning: The assistant consistently provided the requested order status details and shipping address each time, and the user explicitly confirmed their needs were satisfied.

criteria.criterion: The agent provides a shipping address again when asked the second time. Note, this is a voice transcription, so the details are likely to be mis-transcribed and might not be the same as the first mention. Fail only if it refuses or misses the question.
criteria.reasoning: When the user asks again, "can you remind me of the shipping address on that Galaxy Watch order again?", the bot responds with "The shipping address on your Galaxy Watch order ... is: Bahnhofstrasse 42, 8001 Zürich".

criteria.criterion: The agent does not claim it has lost access to data or tools it used moments ago
criteria.reasoning: Nowhere in the transcript does the bot state that it has lost access to prior data or tools; it consistently answers order and address questions without such claims.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not make the customer sit through a full re-listing of every order to answer a follow-up about the order they were just discussing
criteria.reasoning: For follow-up questions about the Galaxy Watch order, the bot directly gives the requested shipping address and does not list other orders or re-list all order details.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not re-ask for information already provided (e.g., which order, when the customer already said "Galaxy Watch" and was just discussing it)
criteria.reasoning: The bot never asks again which order or device is being discussed after the user first mentions the Galaxy Watch; it uses the existing context to answer follow-ups.

scale_metrics_reasoning.helpfulness: Every user request (order status, full details, and repeated shipping address checks) was answered directly, accurately, and with appropriate detail.
scale_metrics_reasoning.repair_quality: There were no user disfluencies or corrections; the user accepted each answer, so no repair was needed or mishandled.
scale_metrics_reasoning.coherence: The assistant consistently referenced the same order and address correctly across turns without contradictions or unnecessary re-asking.
scale_metrics_reasoning.tone: The tone was clear and polite but somewhat formulaic due to repeated abrupt 'Goodbye!' closings after each user acknowledgment.
